get_rendering_parser: get a rendering argument parser with default task single_object_rendering for 3D object rendering
add_rendering_args: add rendering CLI arguments like beam size, resolution, path style, and output types to an argparse parser
parse_args_and_arch: parse command line arguments and architecture config by delegating to fairseq options module
render_camera_poses: render 3D objects using custom camera poses loaded from a text file for testing trajectories
render_output_types: render 3D objects with output types including color, depth, normal, voxel, and point predictions
